module_summary: Valid/ready skid buffer: a one-entry side register captures input data when the downstream stalls, while a registered output stage muxes skid or input data, giving full-throughput registered handshakes.

anchors.name: i_valid
anchors.why: Upstream valid; loads skid register or output register.

anchors.name: o_ready
anchors.why: Upstream ready, low whenever skid register holds data.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Incoming payload captured into skid or output register.

anchors.name: o_valid
anchors.why: Downstream valid driven from registered ro_valid.

anchors.name: i_ready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; stall triggers skid capture, ready drains it.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Registered output payload chosen from skid or input data.

anchors.name: LOGIC.r_valid
anchors.why: Skid-occupied flag; set on downstream stall, drives o_ready and output mux.

anchors.name: LOGIC.r_data
anchors.why: One-entry skid storage holding data accepted during a stall.

anchors.name: LOGIC.REG_OUTPUT.ro_valid
anchors.why: Registered output valid flop behind o_valid.

groups.name: Skid register
groups.description: One-entry overflow buffer and its occupancy flag driving o_ready.

groups.name: Output register
groups.description: Registered valid and data selecting skid or input payload.

groups.name: Input port
groups.description: Upstream valid/data and downstream ready controlling transfers.
